The method of claim 1, wherein selecting, from among the first set of digital components and the second set of digital components a particular digital component comprises: selecting the second set of digital components from a plurality of digital components for which selection values are stored by the secure MPC system based on one or more conditions for each digital component in the plurality of digital components.

3. The method of claim 2, wherein selecting the second set of digital components based on the one or more conditions for each digital component in the plurality of digital components comprises selecting one or more digital components based on (i) a user group check condition for the at least one digital component, (ii) the first secret share of the user data, and (iii) a respective second secret share of the user data received by each second server of the secure MPC system.

4. The method of claim 3, wherein selecting the one or more digital components comprises determining, for each digital component of the one or more digital components and as part of the MPC process, secret shares of a candidate parameter that indicates that the at least digital component is eligible based on the user data indicating that the user is a member of a user group associated with the digital component.
5. The method of claim 4, wherein each server of the secure MPC system determines a respective secret share of the candidate parameter for each of the one or more digital components.
6. The method of claim 2, wherein the one or more conditions for at least one digital component is a pacing condition for pacing distribution of the at least one digital component to user devices.

7. The method of claim 2, wherein the one or more conditions for each digital component in the plurality of digital components comprises a privacy-preserving anonymity enforcement condition that ensures that each digital component is presented to at least a threshold number of users.
